visibleProducts.name: Free route changes
visibleProducts.description:
You can change your route (departure or destination airport) within +/-1 day and will not incur a change fee, but you will have to pay any difference between your original fare and the current FLEXI fare for the new flight.
If the new fare is lower, no refund will be made. 
Changes are subject to seat and route availability and are not guaranteed
See here for more details.
